summary: PhysicsLabRuntime canonical-recipe fence PR #310 exact head 647dca7a78159bb1bf6f61d6e3180ad082d08e2d does not prove that recipe.entities is an exact dense array. It checks #entities equals the canonical 20 and iterates ipairs(), but never rejects non-array/hash keys, so all 20 canonical entries plus an extra field are accepted as a canonical runtime recipe and the extra field is silently ignored during authority construction.
evidence: At PR #310 exact head 647dca7a78159bb1bf6f61d6e3180ad082d08e2d, assertCanonicalRecipe() applies assertPlainTable() to recipe.entities and checks #entities == #CANONICAL_RECIPE.entities

The function then validates only values reached by ipairs(entities); unlike WorldEntity record/origin wrappers, no pairs()-based container-key preflight requires numeric integer keys in [1, canonicalCount]

A plain candidate with canonical indices 1..20 unchanged plus entities.injected = true keeps #entities at 20 and the same ipairs() traversal, so assertCanonicalRecipe() completes and PhysicsLabRuntime.new() registers the canonical population while accepting a noncanonical supplied recipe shape

Repository code search and the current PR #310 review timeline contain no dense/exact entity-list container regression; existing no-execute coverage targets entity-list metatables, nested wrappers/schema keys, canonical population fields, and bounded persistent-state comparison
PR #388 generation-3 transition-fence work intentionally does not carry #310's constructor fence; its own body already requires the eventual integration lineage to preserve both runtime invariants
recommendation: Return the recipe-fence lineage to NEEDS_CHANGES or absorb this in the eventual combined runtime successor: before reading entity entries, enumerate recipe.entities keys and require exactly the dense numeric range 1..#CANONICAL_RECIPE.entities, rejecting string/hash, non-integer, out-of-range, and sparse keys. Add a pure regression with all 20 canonical entries plus an extra hash field (and preferably an out-of-range numeric key) proving rejection before authority registration. Preserve #310's no-execute/bounded-work fence and #388's whole-step mutation fence. No Studio evidence is required or claimed.
